comparison.objective: Sweep twenty cereal rings into a dustpan held flat.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual brush use while stabilizing a thin dustpan lip.
comparison.success_condition: All rings lie past the lip, pan is flat, tools are released, and pieces remain still; dropped tools fail.
comparison.reason: Its stabilization supports bulk sweeping, whereas the candidate requires coaxial driver/wrench countertorque that preserves a calibrated stop and survives cycles.
